messages:
Ravi: Quick sync: staging replay shows many prefetched prefixes getting immediately evicted during bursts. Looking for low-risk options to reduce churn.

Ana: Short list: 1) admission gate (only prefetch when free_residency_pct > X), 2) soft-pin TTL (short-lived, lowest eviction priority), 3) origin-tag bias that decays.

Maya: Admission gate is the least invasive. If we only prefetch when free>30% we avoid most churn. But it also reduces effectiveness under moderate load.

Grant: Soft-pin TTL approach: insert soft entry with ttl=3s, eviction treats soft as lowest priority. If an access occurs we convert to normal entry. Simple and predictable.

Ravi: Two must-haves: a) prefetch must carry prefix_gen to avoid serving stale data if a write occurs, b) metrics for wasted_prefetch_cost and post_prefetch_hit_rate.

infra-bot: recent snapshot:
prefetch_attempts=9.1k/min,prefetch_evicted_soon=2.6k/min(28.6%),post_prefetch_hit_rate_1s=19%

Ana: Proposal: feature flag `prefetch.soft_admission=true` enabling: admission predicate (free_residency_pct>30), soft-pin TTL=3s, per-tenant prefetch_budget to avoid noisy tenants. Start behind flag in staging.

Maya: Tests: replay with write-heavy flows to confirm no stale reads, microbench prefetch cost, and eviction-churn delta. Add unit test for convert-on-access semantics.

Grant: Rollout signals: rollback if eviction_churn_up > 1.4x or p95_latency_up > 10% or stale_read_detected>0.

Ravi: I'll own the flag + prefix_gen validation. Ana will implement admission logic. Maya will add tests and dashboards. Grant will run staging canary and watch alerts.

Ana: Sounds good. After staging, if we see post_prefetch_hit_rate rise or wasted_prefetch drop, we can iterate on thresholds.

Ravi: Thanks. Small PRs, observability-first. :thumbsup:
